stated: The Conservative Party will urgently introduce Martyn’s Law to ensure premises are better prepared for terrorist attacks by requiring them to take proportionate steps to mitigate risks.

source.quote: We will urgently introduce Martyn’s Law, in tribute to Martyn Hett, who was tragically killed alongside 21 others in the Manchester Arena terrorist attack in 2017. This will ensure premises are better prepared for terrorist attacks by requiring them to take proportionate steps to mitigate risks.

bearing_set.reason: Martyn's Law directly addresses terrorism preparedness at public venues, bearing on national security and public safety — a core O5 indicator.

Creates new mandatory compliance obligations on venue operators (security planning, staff training, potential penalties for non-compliance) — a concrete state-coercion/mandate burden on thousands of premises, moving the 'freedom from state coercion (mandates, licensing)' indicator even where the requirement is proportionate.

membership_note: O5 is the primary bearing (protective safety good); O10 captures the genuine but bounded liberty cost imposed on venue operators via compulsory regulatory requirements — consistent with the tradeoff check rule that new mandates, however justified, register a non-negligible worsening on O10.
